title: The Confessional
text: A confessional booth stands alone in a burned church, untouched by the fire that blackened everything around it. Its curtain stirs. A warm, patient voice inside invites confession, and it seems to know already what each of you might say.

options.label: Each Scion steps behind the curtain and confesses.

outcomes.text: A weight lifted, and the voice says nothing at all, kindly.
The voice listens, and thanks them, and tells it to someone else.

options.label: Each Scion listens to the others' sins instead.

outcomes.text: Other people's sins, whispered through the curtain, and useful ones.
